# Journal Figure Profiles

These are conservative defaults for drafting figures. Always treat the target journal's current author instructions as authoritative.

## Source Calibration

- UTD 2026 rankings track publications in 24 top-tier peer-reviewed business journals over the 2021-2025 window.
- Management Science author instructions emphasize manuscript templates, reproducibility materials, and color figures that may be converted to black and white for print.
- Academy of Management Journal welcomes qualitative, quantitative, laboratory, field, meta-analytic, and mixed methods, but expects strong empirical and theoretical contributions.
- Administrative Science Quarterly emphasizes data/methods transparency, APA style from 2025, and careful manuscript length discipline.

## UTD 24 Journal Coverage

| Domain | Journal | Figure Style | Export | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Accounting | The Accounting Review | conservative empirical tables, sparse figures | PDF/EPS | Prioritize editable tables, coefficient plots, and clear notes. |
| Accounting | Journal of Accounting and Economics | finance/accounting empirical style | PDF/EPS | Make event-time and robustness figures black-white readable. |
| Accounting | Journal of Accounting Research | compact empirical style | PDF/EPS | Avoid decorative charts; show identification-relevant variation. |
| Finance | Journal of Finance | black-white friendly event studies and coefficient plots | PDF/EPS | Prefer grayscale robustness and clear SE/CI labels. |
| Finance | Journal of Financial Economics | clean empirical finance style | PDF/EPS | Use direct labels where possible; keep legends small. |
| Finance | Review of Financial Studies | dense but readable empirical style | PDF/EPS | Make axis definitions and portfolio sorts explicit. |
| IS | Information Systems Research | mechanism and experiment-friendly figures | PDF/EPS | Emphasize constructs, treatment arms, and model logic. |
| IS | INFORMS Journal on Computing | algorithm/computation clarity | PDF/EPS/SVG | Show computational comparisons with reproducible scales. |
| IS | MIS Quarterly | theory-model and empirical hybrid style | PDF/EPS | Use clean construct diagrams and readable tables. |
| Marketing | Journal of Consumer Research | experiment and psychology-friendly style | PDF/EPS | Prefer condition means, CIs, and manipulation checks. |
| Marketing | Journal of Marketing | managerial insight plus empirical rigor | PDF/EPS | Keep labels accessible and implications visible. |
| Marketing | Journal of Marketing Research | experimental/quantitative clarity | PDF/EPS | Report uncertainty; avoid overloaded multi-panel figures. |
| Marketing | Marketing Science | analytical and empirical marketing style | PDF/EPS | Show model fit, counterfactuals, and robustness cleanly. |
| OM/OR | Management Science | restrained empirical style, readable coefficients/tables | PDF/EPS | Show identification, robustness, and reproducibility clearly. |
| OM/OR | Operations Research | mathematical/computational precision | PDF/EPS/SVG | Keep notation consistent with the paper. |
| OM/OR | Journal of Operations Management | process and operations evidence clarity | PDF/EPS | Good for process diagrams, field data, and operational metrics. |
| OM/OR | Manufacturing & Service Operations Management | service/operations empirical style | PDF/EPS | Make queue, process, and service metrics explicit. |
| OM/OR | Production and Operations Management | operations and supply-chain style | PDF/EPS | Prefer clear operational interpretation over visual ornament. |
| Management | Academy of Management Journal | theory-driven empirical evidence | PDF/EPS | Figures must serve theoretical contribution, not decoration. |
| Management | Academy of Management Review | conceptual theory figures | PDF/EPS/SVG | Use parsimonious mechanisms, boundary conditions, and propositions. |
| Management | Administrative Science Quarterly | qualitative/process and theory-rich evidence | PDF/EPS | Evidence displays must support transparency and process logic. |
| Management | Organization Science | hybrid theory, process, and empirical style | PDF/EPS | Suitable for process models, networks, and mechanism diagrams. |
| Management | Journal of International Business Studies | international/contextual evidence clarity | PDF/EPS | Label countries, levels, and institutional contexts carefully. |
| Management | Strategic Management Journal | strategy mechanisms and empirical rigor | PDF/EPS | Favor coefficient/event-study/network figures with direct interpretation. |

## Nature-Level Cross-Over Profile

| Journal | Figure Style | Export | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nature | compact, high information density, panel letters, clean sans-serif | PDF/SVG + high-res PNG | Avoid decorative gradients; every panel must answer a question. |
| 管理世界 | Chinese labels, print-friendly grayscale | PDF | 字体、字号、图注和数据来源要完整。 |
| 经济研究 | conservative, table/figure note discipline | PDF | 黑白打印可读优先。 |

## Default Technical Settings

| Profile | Figure Width | Font | Base Font Size | Line Width | Palette |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Nature | 89 mm single-column | Arial | 7-9 pt | 0.8-1.1 pt | colorblind-safe |
| UTD empirical | 86-90 mm single-column | Times New Roman | 8-10 pt | 0.8-1.2 pt | grayscale-safe |
| AOM/ASQ qualitative | 90-120 mm | Times New Roman | 8-10 pt | 0.8-1.1 pt | monochrome plus one accent |
| Chinese journal | 90-120 mm | Songti SC / SimSun | 8-10 pt | 0.8-1.1 pt | grayscale-safe |
